name: unsafe fn insert_after_unchecked (& mut self , value : T)
rule: For `insert_after_unchecked` to be safe, all elements in the `BTreeSet` must remain in sorted order after inserting `value`.
api: impl < 'a , T : Ord , A : Allocator + Clone > alloc::collections::btree::set::CursorMutKey < 'a , T , A > { unsafe fn insert_after_unchecked (& mut self , value : T) }
expression: Cannot express this requirement using the supplied grammar: it provides no ordering operation on T or access to all set elements after insertion.
